usageAttributionFinding.conclusion: Exact phase-level token attribution cannot be reconstructed for intervals crossing phase boundaries. Keep those deltas unallocated; do not assign by duration or checkpoint endpoint. A protocol must provide phase-bounded cumulative baselines or per-phase deltas plus boundary identity.
